source_policy: All audio clips are excerpts from the supplied 2025 RB21 onboard recordings. Inputs are converted to 48 kHz with FFmpeg only when needed; no pitch shifting, intentional time stretching, denoising, or EQ is applied. Short shift clips use audio spectral-flux timing refinement plus 8 ms boundary fades.
alignment: audio time = recording_lap_start_s + telemetry time relative to pole-lap start; first-downshift anchor kept as a fallback.
known_limitations: Onboard recordings are full scene mixes, not isolated engine stems.
OpenF1 car_data samples around 3.7 Hz; telemetry defines an uncertainty interval rather than the exact shift time.
Audio spectral-flux peaks are heuristic candidates and must be listen-checked; missing candidates are left unexported rather than invented.
Intermediate gear labels inside multi-gear telemetry jumps are estimates, not telemetry observations.
Snippets are proof-of-concept state-conditioned samples, not yet a real-time Android engine.
